description: Write the files that let links to your site open your app: Apple's apple-app-site-association (Universal Links) and Android's assetlinks.json (App Links), served under https://{site}/.well-known/. Give ios_app_ids (TEAMID.bundle.id) and android_package with android_sha256 fingerprints, and they are built for you; or pass a whole file as apple_json / android_json. A platform you leave out keeps its file.

android_json.description: A whole assetlinks.json file instead; "" removes it.

android_sha256.description: SHA-256 signing certificate fingerprints (Play Console › App integrity), AA:BB:... form.

apple_json.description: A whole apple-app-site-association file instead; "" removes it.

ios_app_ids.description: App IDs: your Apple team ID, a dot and the bundle id, e.g. ABCDE12345.com.example.app.

ios_paths.description: Paths that open the app; ["*"] (default) for all.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: set_app_links
title: Set App Links files
